description: Vague one-line request: a measurable goal, measure-before-optimise dependencies, and stated assumptions (G10).

arguments.goal: Cut p95 page load on the three busiest pages to under 2 s, measured with Lighthouse and server timings before and after.

steps.title: Measure baseline
steps.acceptance: Lighthouse scores and p95 server timings recorded for the three busiest pages

steps.title: Profile hot paths
steps.acceptance: Top five bottlenecks ranked by time saved

steps.title: Optimise top bottlenecks
steps.acceptance: Each change merged with tests passing

steps.title: Verify against baseline
steps.acceptance: p95 under 2 s on all three pages

assumptions: Faster means page load as users see it, not throughput
The three busiest pages are the ones that matter; found from the access logs

reference.content: Plan: measure a baseline on the three busiest pages, profile, fix the top bottlenecks in parallel, then verify p95 is under 2 s. I assumed you mean user-visible page load; say if you meant throughput. Starting the baseline now.
